summary.ko: 엔드포인트·스키마·오류·호환성을 검토 가능한 API 계약으로 정리합니다.
summary.en: Define or review endpoints, schemas, errors, and compatibility as a coherent API contract.

exclusions: Debugging an already-defined endpoint without a contract issue

required_inputs.description: Consumers, supported operations, and example data shapes
Existing contract or explicit indication this is a new API

workflow.instruction: Map each consumer use case to an operation and distinguish identifiers, ownership, and authorization requirements.
Specify request and response schemas, validation, status codes, pagination, idempotency, and error structure where relevant.
Check examples against schemas and examine nullability, versioning, breaking changes, and retry behavior.
Produce contract examples and contract-test cases; list unresolved product or security decisions separately.

deliverables.name: API contract
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Valid structured endpoint and schema definitions with examples

deliverables.name: Compatibility review
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Calls out breaking changes and positive and negative contract tests

limitations: Do not claim a contract is OpenAPI-valid unless validated against the requested version.
Authentication design needs system context; sample tokens must be obvious placeholders.
permission_boundaries: Do not call live write endpoints, create credentials, or modify access policies.
Use synthetic examples rather than client production records.
